actual: failure: every new case fails because the shipped module has no PATH_EDIT_LIFT_DISABLED_REASON, PATH_EDIT_DEGENERATE_DISABLED_REASON, resolvePaintedCurveEligibility, admitsPathEditWrite member, and resolvePathEditGate ignores the optional curveEntry argument (the gate stays disabled for one eligible painted stroke).
semanticAssessment: All ten new cases execute and fail behaviourally on the planned assertions (undefined constants/predicates, and a gate that ignores the curve entry) rather than at module load or on a fixture fault; the 169 shipped gate/copy cases stay green, so the RED is the missing D-10 law only.
